headline: REalloys Signs Term Sheet for 75-Year Lease at Tooele Army Depot
summary: REalloys has signed a nonbinding term sheet for a 75-year operating lease on 200 acres at the Tooele Army Depot in Utah. The agreement aims to establish a domestic supply chain for heavy rare earths for the U.S. military.
why: Rare earth elements are critical components in defense technology and electronics. Securing a domestic supply chain is a strategic priority for the U.S. government to reduce reliance on foreign sources, particularly China.

impacts.name: REalloys
impacts.why: The company is the primary party in a long-term strategic lease agreement with the U.S. Army.
